advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer JET$ LYF3: Antonio Williams + Eli Raridon for Garrett Wilson.
Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.4 points a week) and drop Matt Hibner.

reasons: You're 15-7 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 23%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 1st of 8 contenders (173.7 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 23%, 17%, 22%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 23% to 26%, and your lineup comes out 2.0 points a week ahead overall. Antonio Williams + Eli Raridon add 2.4 points a week for you today, but Garrett Wilson is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 3,459, get 3,562), and it helps their lineup too (+1.3 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 17% and 22% to 27% and 23%.
You have 2 weeks until the trade deadline.
